title: TNT Dupe Advancement Datapack
description: Advancement datapack addon for the TNT dupe plugin
body:
***THIS DATAPACK ONLY WORKS WITH THE TNT DUPE PLUGIN. It is designed as an addon only*** (https://modrinth.com/plugin/tnt-dupe/version/1.5-26.1.x)

Adds 3 advancements for the TNT Dupe plugin 

1.Trade with a villager to recieve the book.

2.Combining the book & TNT on an anvil.

3.Using the TNT in a dispenser or dropper

You must enable advancements in the TNT Dupe plugin config.yml file
